_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score sits in a tight coil with only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over the last week, making HOLD the statistically grounded call while the market decides between accumulation resuming or a Panic retest.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative writer leans toward an imminent upside snapback while the analyst insists on waiting for concrete breakers (ETF flow reversal >30 or VIX >25 / DXY >102) before committing directionally.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 with BTC holding $62k and funding staying below 0.005%, confirming accumulation resuming and pushing toward Hope.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 with DXY breaking 102 and funding flipping negative, invalidating consolidation and signaling a Panic retest.
